update_source_checks.snapshot_status: 2024 final plus full-guideline corrigenda [July 2024](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.kint.2024.04.003) and [February 2025](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.kint.2024.10.004), confirmed October 7. This is distinct from the executive-summary erratum. Scope review and original-file incorporation remain separate.
